rows.jp: 「心に愛があったことだけは認めよう」

ghs.assessment: The line acknowledges that Miki at least had love in her heart when trying to help. “There was love in my heart” assigns that motive to the speaker instead.

ghs.en: She had raised her head and Miki's head is red.

ghs.remedy: Use “Miki raised her head; her face was red.”

highlights.text: She had raised her head and Miki's head is red.

rows.jp: 砂浜になにか切れる破片がまざっていたんだ。
rows.en: There must have been something sharp mixed into the sand.

ghs.en: Something that had cut off and splintered mixed in the sand of the beach.

ghs.remedy: Use “There must have been a sharp fragment mixed into the sand.”

highlights.text: Something that had cut off and splintered mixed in the sand of the beach.

rows.en: A crawling shudder ran up my spine.

highlights.text: Taichi: "At least someone realized about the tea. Who was it?"

rows.jp: 「混乱してる時に、視界のはしに誰かいたような」

rows.jp: 最終進化過程をすでに迎えブロントサウルスにも似た迫力を兼ね備えているその器官が、いたいけな少女の眼前にずるむけにされた（二重に）。
rows.en: The organ, already at the final stage of its evolution and endowed with the presence of a brontosaurus, was laid bare before an innocent girl—twice over, in fact.

ghs.en: This organ that possesses an impact and a strength similar to that of a brontosaurus that has already welcomed the final stage of its evolution is presented to the eyes of this innocent girl via the slips (both meanings).
ghs.assessment: The source’s parenthetical signals a double exposure or double meaning in ずるむけ. “Via the slips (both meanings)” invents an English “slips” mechanism that does not express the Japanese action or pun.
ghs.remedy: Describe the organ being laid fully bare and handle the parenthetical without an invented “slips” gloss.

highlights.text: This organ that possesses an impact and a strength similar to that of a brontosaurus that has already welcomed the final stage of its evolution is presented to the eyes of this innocent girl via the slips (both meanings).

rows.jp: 父親を知らない清純派少女は、ゆっくりと、顔色ひとつ変えず、悲鳴さえあげず……気を失って倒れた。
rows.en: The sheltered girl who had never known her father slowly, without so much as a change of expression or even a scream…… fainted dead away.

ghs.en: This girl so pure who's never known her father, gently, as her complexion changes color not, as she emits a loud scream not... parts with consciousness and falls down.
ghs.assessment: The source says the girl faints slowly without changing expression or even screaming. “As her complexion changes color not” and “emits a loud scream not” are distorted negative calques.
ghs.remedy: Use natural parallel negatives: “without a change in expression, without even a scream.”

highlights.text: This girl so pure who's never known her father, gently, as her complexion changes color not, as she emits a loud scream not... parts with consciousness and falls down.

rows.jp: 桐原は友貴の超竜ボーギャック（命名）を見てどこかに逃げてしまった。
rows.en: Touko Kirihara saw Tomoki’s Ultra-Dragon Bogyak (my name for it) and fled somewhere.

ghs.en: Kirihara, upon sight of Tomoki's Hyper Dragon Bojack (thus christened), ran away who knows where.

rows.jp: 口うるさいくせに軟弱者である。
rows.en: For all her bluster, she was a coward.

ghs.en: That damn nitpicker got her own weaknesses.
ghs.assessment: The source calls Touko a coward despite how loudly she nags. “Got her own weaknesses” generalizes that specific contradiction into unspecified flaws.
ghs.remedy: Use “For all her nagging, she’s a coward.”

highlights.text: That damn nitpicker got her own weaknesses.

rows.jp: 気絶した遊紗ちゃんは、宮澄先輩が介抱した。
rows.en: Misato tended to Yusa while she was unconscious.

ghs.en: Miyasumi-senpai is looking after poor fainted Yusa-chan.
ghs.assessment: The source says Miyasumi-senpai looked after the unconscious Yusa. The English shifts to present progressive and adds the evaluative “poor.”
ghs.remedy: Use “Miyasumi-senpai looked after the unconscious Yusa-chan.”

highlights.text: Miyasumi-senpai is looking after poor fainted Yusa-chan.

rows.jp: その先輩にしても、呆れ半分照れ半分で、顔が朱色になっている。
rows.en: Even Misato was half exasperated, half embarrassed, her face flushed scarlet.

ghs.en: Said Senpai had yet turned deep crimson in the face, half-disgusted, half-embarrassed.

ghs.assessment: The narrator spitefully echoes “Be finished, be finished” at Tomoki. “Do be finished, do be” sounds like a polite request and loses the blunt repetition.
ghs.remedy: Use “Good. Be finished. Be finished.”

highlights.text: Do be finished, do be!

rows.jp: 「落ち込むなよ、卒業まで俺たちはチェリーボーイズでいるって誓いを忘れたか」
rows.en: “Don’t be so down. Have you forgotten our vow to remain virgins until graduation?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Don't toss yourself down! Did you forget the vow we've made to remain Cherry BoyZ until graduation?"
ghs.assessment: 落ち込むな means “Don’t get depressed,” not “Don’t toss yourself down.” “Cherry BoyZ” also adds decorative spelling absent from the source.
ghs.remedy: Use “Don’t get depressed. Have you forgotten our vow to stay virgins until graduation?”

highlights.text: Taichi: "Don't toss yourself down! Did you forget the vow we've made to remain Cherry BoyZ until graduation?"

rows.jp: がっくりと肩を落とす。

rows.en: “Sigh... Guess I’ll go for a swim.”

ghs.assessment: The source says he will accompany Tomoki. “I’ll go with” is missing its object in standard English.
ghs.remedy: Use “I’ll go with you.”

highlights.text: Taichi: "I'll go with."

rows.jp: 「俺はずっと気になっていたのだが」
rows.en: “There’s something I’ve been wondering about for a while.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "That thing that was on my mind before."
ghs.assessment: The source introduces something he has been wondering about all along. “That thing that was on my mind before” turns it into an old, completed concern and does not ask or state it clearly.
ghs.remedy: Use “There’s something I’ve been wondering this whole time.”

highlights.text: Taichi: "That thing that was on my mind before."

ghs.assessment: うーむ is a doubtful or contemplative “Hmm.” “Yep” turns hesitation into affirmative certainty.
ghs.remedy: Use “Hmm...”

highlights.text: Tomoki: "A dumb beach outing, wasn't this."

rows.jp: 言うと、友貴は嘆息しつつも、首肯を返してきた。

ghs.remedy: Use “Tomoki sighed, but nodded.”

highlights.text: To my words, Tomoki gave a sigh while still returning his agreement.
